source_units.text: The vision that Isaiah son of Amos saw, which he saw against Judea and against Jerusalem during the reign of Oziah, Joatham, Achaz and Hezekiah, who reigned over Judea.
source_units.display_text: The vision that Isaiah son of Amos saw, which he saw against Judea and against Jerusalem during the reign of Oziah, Joatham, Achaz and Hezekiah, who reigned over Judea.

source_units.text: Listen, heaven, and give ear, earth, because the Lord has spoken: “I begot sons and raised them high, but they rejected Me.
source_units.display_text: Listen, heaven, and give ear, earth, because the Lord has spoken: “I begot sons and raised them high, but they rejected Me.

source_units.text: An ox knew the one who acquired it, and a donkey its lord’s manger; but Israel did not know Me, and the people did not understand Me.”
source_units.display_text: An ox knew the one who acquired it, and a donkey its lord’s manger; but Israel did not know Me, and the people did not understand Me.”

source_units.text: Woe, sinful nation, people full of sins, evil offspring, lawless sons! You abandoned the Lord and provoked the Holy One of Israel to anger.
source_units.display_text: Woe, sinful nation, people full of sins, evil offspring, lawless sons! You abandoned the Lord and provoked the Holy One of Israel to anger.

source_units.text: Why should you be struck again as you add lawlessness? Every head is in pain, and every heart in grief.
source_units.display_text: Why should you be struck again as you add lawlessness? Every head is in pain, and every heart in grief.

source_units.text: From feet to head: for neither a wound nor a bruise nor an inflamed blow is there a poultice to apply, nor oil nor bandages.
source_units.display_text: From feet to head: for neither a wound nor a bruise nor an inflamed blow is there a poultice to apply, nor oil nor bandages.

source_units.text: Your land is deserted, your cities burned by fire. Your country—foreigners consume it before you; it has been deserted, overturned by foreign peoples.
source_units.display_text: Your land is deserted, your cities burned by fire. Your country—foreigners consume it before you; it has been deserted, overturned by foreign peoples.

source_units.text: Daughter Zion will be left like a tent in a vineyard, like a fruit-watcher’s shelter in a cucumber field, like a besieged city.
source_units.display_text: Daughter Zion will be left like a tent in a vineyard, like a fruit-watcher’s shelter in a cucumber field, like a besieged city.

source_units.text: If the Lord Sabaoth had not left us seed, we would have become like Sodom and been made like Gomorrah.
source_units.display_text: If the Lord Sabaoth had not left us seed, we would have become like Sodom and been made like Gomorrah.

source_units.text: Hear the Lord’s word, rulers of Sodom! Attend to God’s law, people of Gomorrah!
source_units.display_text: Hear the Lord’s word, rulers of Sodom! Attend to God’s law, people of Gomorrah!

source_units.text: “What is the multitude of your sacrifices to Me?” says the Lord. “I am full of burnt offerings of rams; fat of lambs and blood of bulls and male goats I do not desire,
source_units.display_text: “What is the multitude of your sacrifices to Me?” says the Lord. “I am full of burnt offerings of rams; fat of lambs and blood of bulls and male goats I do not desire,

source_units.text: not even if you come to appear before Me. For who demanded these things from your hands? To trample My court,
source_units.display_text: not even if you come to appear before Me. For who demanded these things from your hands? To trample My court,

source_units.text: you will no longer continue. If you bring fine flour, it is futile. Incense is an abomination to Me. Your new moons and sabbaths and a great day I cannot endure; fasting and idleness,
source_units.display_text: you will no longer continue. If you bring fine flour, it is futile. Incense is an abomination to Me. Your new moons and sabbaths and a great day I cannot endure; fasting and idleness,

source_units.text: and your new moons and your festivals My soul hates. You have become more than enough for Me; I will no longer let your sins go.
source_units.display_text: and your new moons and your festivals My soul hates. You have become more than enough for Me; I will no longer let your sins go.

source_units.text: Whenever you stretch your hands toward Me, I will turn My eyes away from you. Even if you multiply supplication, I will not listen to you, for your hands are full of blood.
source_units.display_text: Whenever you stretch your hands toward Me, I will turn My eyes away from you. Even if you multiply supplication, I will not listen to you, for your hands are full of blood.

source_units.text: Wash yourselves, become clean. Remove the evils from your souls, before My eyes. Stop your evil deeds.
source_units.display_text: Wash yourselves, become clean. Remove the evils from your souls, before My eyes. Stop your evil deeds.

source_units.text: Learn to do good, seek judgment, rescue the wronged. Give judgment for the orphan and vindicate the widow.
source_units.display_text: Learn to do good, seek judgment, rescue the wronged. Give judgment for the orphan and vindicate the widow.

source_units.text: Come, let us reason together, says the Lord. Though your sins are like purple-red, I will whiten them like snow; though they are like scarlet, I will whiten them like wool.
source_units.display_text: Come, let us reason together, says the Lord. Though your sins are like purple-red, I will whiten them like snow; though they are like scarlet, I will whiten them like wool.

source_units.text: If you are willing and listen to Me, you will eat the land’s good things.
source_units.display_text: If you are willing and listen to Me, you will eat the land’s good things.

source_units.text: But if you are unwilling and do not listen to Me, a sword will devour you, for the Lord’s mouth has spoken these things.”
source_units.display_text: But if you are unwilling and do not listen to Me, a sword will devour you, for the Lord’s mouth has spoken these things.”

source_units.text: How the faithful city Zion has become a prostitute, full of judgment, in which righteousness lay at rest, but now murderers!
source_units.display_text: How the faithful city Zion has become a prostitute, full of judgment, in which righteousness lay at rest, but now murderers!

source_units.text: Your silver is unapproved; your retailers mix the wine with water.
source_units.display_text: Your silver is unapproved; your retailers mix the wine with water.

source_units.text: Your rulers disobey, partners of thieves, loving gifts and pursuing repayment, not judging for orphans and not attending to widows’ judgment.
source_units.display_text: Your rulers disobey, partners of thieves, loving gifts and pursuing repayment, not judging for orphans and not attending to widows’ judgment.

source_units.text: Therefore thus says the Master, the Lord Sabaoth: “Woe, mighty ones of Israel! For My anger will not cease among My opponents, and I will exact judgment from My enemies.
source_units.display_text: Therefore thus says the Master, the Lord Sabaoth: “Woe, mighty ones of Israel! For My anger will not cease among My opponents, and I will exact judgment from My enemies.

source_units.text: I will bring My hand against you and burn you to purity. I will destroy the disobedient, remove all lawless people from you and humble all the arrogant.
source_units.display_text: I will bring My hand against you and burn you to purity. I will destroy the disobedient, remove all lawless people from you and humble all the arrogant.

source_units.text: I will establish your judges as before and your counselors as at the beginning. After these things you will be called City of Righteousness, Faithful Metropolis Zion.
source_units.display_text: I will establish your judges as before and your counselors as at the beginning. After these things you will be called City of Righteousness, Faithful Metropolis Zion.

source_units.text: For her captivity will be saved through judgment and through mercy.
source_units.display_text: For her captivity will be saved through judgment and through mercy.

source_units.text: The lawless and sinners will be shattered together, and those abandoning the Lord will be brought to an end.
source_units.display_text: The lawless and sinners will be shattered together, and those abandoning the Lord will be brought to an end.

source_units.text: For they will be ashamed of their idols, which they themselves wanted, and they were disgraced by their gardens, which they desired.
source_units.display_text: For they will be ashamed of their idols, which they themselves wanted, and they were disgraced by their gardens, which they desired.

source_units.text: For they will be like a terebinth that has shed its leaves, like a garden that has no water.
source_units.display_text: For they will be like a terebinth that has shed its leaves, like a garden that has no water.

source_units.text: Their strength will become a stalk of tow and their works sparks of fire. The lawless and sinners will be burned together, with no one to quench.”
source_units.display_text: Their strength will become a stalk of tow and their works sparks of fire. The lawless and sinners will be burned together, with no one to quench.”

source_units.text: The word that came from the Lord to Isaiah son of Amos concerning Judea and Jerusalem.
source_units.display_text: The word that came from the Lord to Isaiah son of Amos concerning Judea and Jerusalem.

source_units.text: In the last days the Lord’s mountain and God’s house will be clearly visible on the summits of the mountains and be raised above the hills; all the nations will come to it,
source_units.display_text: In the last days the Lord’s mountain and God’s house will be clearly visible on the summits of the mountains and be raised above the hills; all the nations will come to it,

source_units.text: and many nations will go and say, “Come, let us go up to the Lord’s mountain and to the house of Jacob’s God. He will announce His way to us, and we will walk in it.” For law will go out from Zion, and the Lord’s word from Jerusalem.
source_units.display_text: and many nations will go and say, “Come, let us go up to the Lord’s mountain and to the house of Jacob’s God. He will announce His way to us, and we will walk in it.” For law will go out from Zion, and the Lord’s word from Jerusalem.

source_units.text: He will judge between the nations and reprove a numerous people. They will beat their swords into plows and their spears into sickles. Nation will no longer take sword against nation, and they will certainly no longer learn to wage war.
source_units.display_text: He will judge between the nations and reprove a numerous people. They will beat their swords into plows and their spears into sickles. Nation will no longer take sword against nation, and they will certainly no longer learn to wage war.

source_units.text: And now, house of Jacob, come, let us walk by the Lord’s light!
source_units.display_text: And now, house of Jacob, come, let us walk by the Lord’s light!

source_units.text: For He abandoned His people, Israel’s house, because their country was filled, as from the beginning, with omens like the foreigners’ country, and many foreign children were born to them.
source_units.display_text: For He abandoned His people, Israel’s house, because their country was filled, as from the beginning, with omens like the foreigners’ country, and many foreign children were born to them.

source_units.text: For their country was filled with silver and gold, and their treasures had no number; the land was filled with horses, and their chariots had no number.
source_units.display_text: For their country was filled with silver and gold, and their treasures had no number; the land was filled with horses, and their chariots had no number.

source_units.text: The land was filled with abominations, the works of their hands, and they bowed before what their fingers made.
source_units.display_text: The land was filled with abominations, the works of their hands, and they bowed before what their fingers made.

source_units.text: A human being bowed down, and a man was humbled; I will certainly not let them go.
source_units.display_text: A human being bowed down, and a man was humbled; I will certainly not let them go.

source_units.text: And now enter the rocks and hide in the earth from the Lord’s terror and the glory of His strength, whenever He rises to shatter the earth.
source_units.display_text: And now enter the rocks and hide in the earth from the Lord’s terror and the glory of His strength, whenever He rises to shatter the earth.

source_units.text: For the Lord’s eyes are high, but the human being is low; humanity’s height will be humbled, and the Lord alone will be exalted on that day.
source_units.display_text: For the Lord’s eyes are high, but the human being is low; humanity’s height will be humbled, and the Lord alone will be exalted on that day.

source_units.text: For the Lord Sabaoth has a day against every insolent and arrogant person, against everyone high and elevated; they will be humbled,
source_units.display_text: For the Lord Sabaoth has a day against every insolent and arrogant person, against everyone high and elevated; they will be humbled,

source_units.text: against every cedar of Lebanon among the high and elevated, and against every oak tree of Bashan,
source_units.display_text: against every cedar of Lebanon among the high and elevated, and against every oak tree of Bashan,

source_units.text: against every mountain and every high hill,
source_units.display_text: against every mountain and every high hill,

source_units.text: against every high tower and every high wall,
source_units.display_text: against every high tower and every high wall,

source_units.text: against every ship of the sea and every beautiful display of ships.
source_units.display_text: against every ship of the sea and every beautiful display of ships.

source_units.text: Every human being will be humbled, humanity’s height will fall, and the Lord alone will be exalted on that day.
source_units.display_text: Every human being will be humbled, humanity’s height will fall, and the Lord alone will be exalted on that day.

source_units.text: They will hide away all the handmade things,
source_units.display_text: They will hide away all the handmade things,

source_units.text: carrying them into caves, into clefts in the rocks and into holes in the earth, from the Lord’s terror and the glory of His strength, whenever He rises to shatter the earth.
source_units.display_text: carrying them into caves, into clefts in the rocks and into holes in the earth, from the Lord’s terror and the glory of His strength, whenever He rises to shatter the earth.

source_units.text: For on that day a person will cast out his silver and gold abominations, which they made to worship, to the worthless ones and the bats,
source_units.display_text: For on that day a person will cast out his silver and gold abominations, which they made to worship, to the worthless ones and the bats,

source_units.text: to enter holes in the solid rock and clefts in the rocks from the Lord’s terror and the glory of His strength, whenever He rises to shatter the earth.
source_units.display_text: to enter holes in the solid rock and clefts in the rocks from the Lord’s terror and the glory of His strength, whenever He rises to shatter the earth.

source_units.text: Look now, the Master, the Lord Sabaoth, will remove from Judea and Jerusalem strong man and strong woman, the strength of bread and the strength of water,
source_units.display_text: Look now, the Master, the Lord Sabaoth, will remove from Judea and Jerusalem strong man and strong woman, the strength of bread and the strength of water,

source_units.text: giant and strong man and warrior and judge and prophet and conjecturer and elder,
source_units.display_text: giant and strong man and warrior and judge and prophet and conjecturer and elder,

source_units.text: commander of fifty and admirable counselor and wise master builder and discerning listener.
source_units.display_text: commander of fifty and admirable counselor and wise master builder and discerning listener.

source_units.text: I will establish young men as their rulers, and mockers will lord it over them.
source_units.display_text: I will establish young men as their rulers, and mockers will lord it over them.

source_units.text: The people will clash, person against person and each against his neighbor. The child will collide with the elder, the dishonored with the honored.
source_units.display_text: The people will clash, person against person and each against his neighbor. The child will collide with the elder, the dishonored with the honored.

source_units.text: For a man will seize his brother or a member of his father’s household, saying, “You have a cloak; become our leader, and let my food be under you!”
source_units.display_text: For a man will seize his brother or a member of his father’s household, saying, “You have a cloak; become our leader, and let my food be under you!”

source_units.text: Answering on that day, he will say, “I will not be your leader, for there is neither bread nor cloak in my house. I will not be leader of this people.”
source_units.display_text: Answering on that day, he will say, “I will not be your leader, for there is neither bread nor cloak in my house. I will not be leader of this people.”

source_units.text: For Jerusalem has been abandoned and Judea has collapsed; their tongues accompany lawlessness, disobeying what concerns the Lord, because now their glory has been humbled,
source_units.display_text: For Jerusalem has been abandoned and Judea has collapsed; their tongues accompany lawlessness, disobeying what concerns the Lord, because now their glory has been humbled,

source_units.text: and the shame of their face stood against them. They announced their sin like Sodom’s and made it manifest. Woe to their soul, for they have planned an evil plan against themselves,
source_units.display_text: and the shame of their face stood against them. They announced their sin like Sodom’s and made it manifest. Woe to their soul, for they have planned an evil plan against themselves,

source_units.text: saying, “Let us bind the righteous person, because he is troublesome to us.” Therefore they will eat the produce of their works.
source_units.display_text: saying, “Let us bind the righteous person, because he is troublesome to us.” Therefore they will eat the produce of their works.

source_units.text: Woe to the lawless! Evils according to the works of his hands will happen to him.
source_units.display_text: Woe to the lawless! Evils according to the works of his hands will happen to him.

source_units.text: My people, your collectors glean you, and those demanding payment lord it over you. My people, those pronouncing you blessed lead you astray and disturb the path of your feet.
source_units.display_text: My people, your collectors glean you, and those demanding payment lord it over you. My people, those pronouncing you blessed lead you astray and disturb the path of your feet.

source_units.text: But now the Lord will establish Himself for judgment and will set His people before judgment.
source_units.display_text: But now the Lord will establish Himself for judgment and will set His people before judgment.

source_units.text: The Lord Himself will come to judgment with the people’s elders and its rulers: “Why have you burned My vineyard, while the poor person’s plunder is in your houses?
source_units.display_text: The Lord Himself will come to judgment with the people’s elders and its rulers: “Why have you burned My vineyard, while the poor person’s plunder is in your houses?

source_units.text: Why do you wrong My people and shame the face of the poor?”
source_units.display_text: Why do you wrong My people and shame the face of the poor?”

source_units.text: Thus says the Lord: “Because Zion’s daughters were exalted and walked with high neck and glancing eyes, dragging their tunics as their feet moved and playing with their feet,
source_units.display_text: Thus says the Lord: “Because Zion’s daughters were exalted and walked with high neck and glancing eyes, dragging their tunics as their feet moved and playing with their feet,

source_units.text: God will humble Zion’s ruling daughters, and the Lord will uncover their appearance
source_units.display_text: God will humble Zion’s ruling daughters, and the Lord will uncover their appearance

source_units.text: on that day, and the Lord will remove the glory of their clothing and their ornaments, hair braids, fringes and crescents,
source_units.display_text: on that day, and the Lord will remove the glory of their clothing and their ornaments, hair braids, fringes and crescents,

source_units.text: the necklace and the adornment of their face,
source_units.display_text: the necklace and the adornment of their face,

source_units.text: the arrangement of glorious adornment, armlets, bracelets, a hair braid, armbands, rings and earrings,
source_units.display_text: the arrangement of glorious adornment, armlets, bracelets, a hair braid, armbands, rings and earrings,

source_units.text: the garments bordered with purple and those purple at the center,
source_units.display_text: the garments bordered with purple and those purple at the center,

source_units.text: the coverings used about the house and the transparent Laconian garments,
source_units.display_text: the coverings used about the house and the transparent Laconian garments,

source_units.text: the fine-linen, blue-purple and scarlet garments, and fine linen interwoven with gold and blue-purple, and trailing summer wraps.
source_units.display_text: the fine-linen, blue-purple and scarlet garments, and fine linen interwoven with gold and blue-purple, and trailing summer wraps.

source_units.text: Instead of sweet fragrance there will be dust; instead of a belt you will gird yourself with a cord; instead of golden head adornment you will have baldness because of your deeds; instead of the tunic with purple at its center you will gird yourself with sackcloth.
source_units.display_text: Instead of sweet fragrance there will be dust; instead of a belt you will gird yourself with a cord; instead of golden head adornment you will have baldness because of your deeds; instead of the tunic with purple at its center you will gird yourself with sackcloth.

source_units.text: Your most beautiful son, whom you love, will fall by the sword, and your strong men will fall by the sword.
source_units.display_text: Your most beautiful son, whom you love, will fall by the sword, and your strong men will fall by the sword.

source_units.text: The cases of your adornment will be humbled and mourn; you will be left alone and dashed to the ground.”
source_units.display_text: The cases of your adornment will be humbled and mourn; you will be left alone and dashed to the ground.”

source_units.text: Seven women will take hold of one man, saying, “We will eat our own bread and put on our own clothes; only let your name be called over us. Take away our disgrace!”
source_units.display_text: Seven women will take hold of one man, saying, “We will eat our own bread and put on our own clothes; only let your name be called over us. Take away our disgrace!”

source_units.text: On that day God will shine out in counsel with glory upon the earth, to exalt and glorify what remains of Israel,
source_units.display_text: On that day God will shine out in counsel with glory upon the earth, to exalt and glorify what remains of Israel,

source_units.text: and those remaining in Zion and left in Jerusalem will be called holy, all those recorded for life in Jerusalem,
source_units.display_text: and those remaining in Zion and left in Jerusalem will be called holy, all those recorded for life in Jerusalem,

source_units.text: because the Lord will wash away the filth of Zion’s sons and daughters and thoroughly cleanse the blood from their midst, by a spirit of judgment and a spirit of burning.
source_units.display_text: because the Lord will wash away the filth of Zion’s sons and daughters and thoroughly cleanse the blood from their midst, by a spirit of judgment and a spirit of burning.

source_units.text: He will come, and it will be: a cloud will shade every place of Mount Zion and everything around her by day, and as of smoke and as of a light of fire burning by night; with all the glory it will be covered.
source_units.display_text: He will come, and it will be: a cloud will shade every place of Mount Zion and everything around her by day, and as of smoke and as of a light of fire burning by night; with all the glory it will be covered.

source_units.text: It will be shade from heat, shelter and concealment from harshness and rain.
source_units.display_text: It will be shade from heat, shelter and concealment from harshness and rain.

source_units.text: I will sing now to the beloved a song of the loved one for my vineyard. The beloved had a vineyard on a horn, in a fertile place.
source_units.display_text: I will sing now to the beloved a song of the loved one for my vineyard. The beloved had a vineyard on a horn, in a fertile place.

source_units.text: I put a fence around it, surrounded it with a palisade, planted a Sorech vine, built a tower in its midst and dug a wine vat in it. I waited for it to produce grapes, but it produced thorns.
source_units.display_text: I put a fence around it, surrounded it with a palisade, planted a Sorech vine, built a tower in its midst and dug a wine vat in it. I waited for it to produce grapes, but it produced thorns.

source_units.text: Now, man of Judah and residents of Jerusalem, judge My case and the matter of My vineyard.
source_units.display_text: Now, man of Judah and residents of Jerusalem, judge My case and the matter of My vineyard.

source_units.text: What more shall I do for My vineyard that I did not do for it? For I waited for it to produce grapes, but it produced thorns.
source_units.display_text: What more shall I do for My vineyard that I did not do for it? For I waited for it to produce grapes, but it produced thorns.

source_units.text: Now I will announce to you what I will do to My vineyard: I will remove its fence, and it will be plundered; I will pull down its wall, and it will be trampled,
source_units.display_text: Now I will announce to you what I will do to My vineyard: I will remove its fence, and it will be plundered; I will pull down its wall, and it will be trampled,

source_units.text: and I will abandon My vineyard. It will certainly not be pruned or dug, and thorns will rise in it as in fallow ground. I will command the clouds not to rain upon it.
source_units.display_text: and I will abandon My vineyard. It will certainly not be pruned or dug, and thorns will rise in it as in fallow ground. I will command the clouds not to rain upon it.

source_units.text: For the vineyard of the Lord Sabaoth is Israel’s house, and the man of Judah a beloved new planting. I waited for it to produce judgment, but it produced lawlessness, not righteousness but an outcry.
source_units.display_text: For the vineyard of the Lord Sabaoth is Israel’s house, and the man of Judah a beloved new planting. I waited for it to produce judgment, but it produced lawlessness, not righteousness but an outcry.

source_units.text: Woe to those joining house to house and bringing field beside field, so that they may take something from their neighbor! Surely you will not dwell alone upon the earth?
source_units.display_text: Woe to those joining house to house and bringing field beside field, so that they may take something from their neighbor! Surely you will not dwell alone upon the earth?

source_units.text: For these things were heard in the ears of the Lord Sabaoth: “If many houses come to be, great and beautiful, they will become deserted, and no one will inhabit them.
source_units.display_text: For these things were heard in the ears of the Lord Sabaoth: “If many houses come to be, great and beautiful, they will become deserted, and no one will inhabit them.

source_units.text: For where ten pairs of oxen work, it will yield one jar, and the one sowing six artabas will yield three measures.”
source_units.display_text: For where ten pairs of oxen work, it will yield one jar, and the one sowing six artabas will yield three measures.”

source_units.text: Woe to those rising in the morning and pursuing strong drink, lingering into the evening, for wine will burn them up!
source_units.display_text: Woe to those rising in the morning and pursuing strong drink, lingering into the evening, for wine will burn them up!

source_units.text: For with lyre and harp, drums and flutes they drink wine, but they do not look at the Lord’s works or consider the works of His hands.
source_units.display_text: For with lyre and harp, drums and flutes they drink wine, but they do not look at the Lord’s works or consider the works of His hands.

source_units.text: Therefore My people became captive because they did not know the Lord, and there was a multitude of dead through famine and thirst for water.
source_units.display_text: Therefore My people became captive because they did not know the Lord, and there was a multitude of dead through famine and thirst for water.

source_units.text: Hades enlarged its appetite and opened its mouth without ceasing, and her glorious ones, great ones, rich ones and pestilent ones will go down.
source_units.display_text: Hades enlarged its appetite and opened its mouth without ceasing, and her glorious ones, great ones, rich ones and pestilent ones will go down.

source_units.text: A human being will be humbled, a man dishonored, and lofty eyes humbled.
source_units.display_text: A human being will be humbled, a man dishonored, and lofty eyes humbled.

source_units.text: The Lord Sabaoth will be exalted through judgment, and the holy God will be glorified through righteousness.
source_units.display_text: The Lord Sabaoth will be exalted through judgment, and the holy God will be glorified through righteousness.

source_units.text: Those who were plundered will be pastured like bulls, and lambs will feed upon the deserted places of those wiped out.
source_units.display_text: Those who were plundered will be pastured like bulls, and lambs will feed upon the deserted places of those wiped out.

source_units.text: Woe to those drawing sins as with a long cord and lawless deeds as with the strap of a heifer’s yoke,
source_units.display_text: Woe to those drawing sins as with a long cord and lawless deeds as with the strap of a heifer’s yoke,

source_units.text: who say, “Let what He will do approach quickly, so that we may see, and let the counsel of the Holy One of Israel come, so that we may know!”
source_units.display_text: who say, “Let what He will do approach quickly, so that we may see, and let the counsel of the Holy One of Israel come, so that we may know!”

source_units.text: Woe to those calling evil good and good evil, making darkness light and light darkness, making bitter sweet and sweet bitter!
source_units.display_text: Woe to those calling evil good and good evil, making darkness light and light darkness, making bitter sweet and sweet bitter!

source_units.text: Woe to those who are discerning in their own judgment and knowledgeable in their own view!
source_units.display_text: Woe to those who are discerning in their own judgment and knowledgeable in their own view!

source_units.text: Woe to your strong ones who drink wine and the powerful who mix strong drink,
source_units.display_text: Woe to your strong ones who drink wine and the powerful who mix strong drink,

source_units.text: The Lord Sabaoth was enraged with wrath against His people, brought His hand against them and struck them. The mountains were roused, and their carcasses became like dung in the middle of the road. In all these things the anger did not turn away, but the hand is still high.

source_units.text: In the year that King Oziah died, I saw the Lord seated on a throne, high and lifted up; and the house was full of His glory.
source_units.display_text: In the year that King Oziah died, I saw the Lord seated on a throne, high and lifted up; and the house was full of His glory.

source_units.text: And seraphim stood around Him: each one had six wings, and each one had six wings; with two they covered their faces, and with two they covered their feet, and with two they flew.

source_units.text: And one cried to another, saying: Holy, holy, holy is the Lord Sabaoth; all the earth is full of His glory.
And the lintel was lifted at the sound of their cry, and the house was filled with smoke.

source_units.text: And I said, Woe is me, for I am pierced to the heart! For I am a man of unclean lips, and I dwell among a people of unclean lips; and my eyes have seen the King, the Lord Sabaoth.
source_units.display_text: And I said, Woe is me, for I am pierced to the heart! For I am a man of unclean lips, and I dwell among a people of unclean lips; and my eyes have seen the King, the Lord Sabaoth.

source_units.text: And I heard the voice of the Lord, saying, Whom shall I send, and who will go to this people? And I said, Behold, here I am; send me.

source_units.text: And He said, Go, and say to this people: Hearing, you will hear and certainly not understand; and seeing, you will see and certainly not perceive.

For the heart of this people has grown dull, and with their ears they have heard heavily, and they have closed their eyes; lest they see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and understand with their heart, and turn, and I will heal them.

source_units.text: And I said, How long, O Lord? And He said: Until cities lie waste, without inhabitants, and houses, without people, and the land is left desolate.
